d: Eastern Gate Trading & Marketing is looking for a hands-on and disciplined Materials Coordinator – Warehouse & Inventory Control (QA/QC) to support our Inventory Controller in maintaining accurate, organized, and system-driven warehouse operations.

This role is ideal for someone who has practical warehouse experience, exposure to ERP-based inventory systems, strong product handling knowledge, and the ability to work in a structured organization where SOPs, documentation, stock accuracy, and housekeeping are treated seriously.

This is not a purely administrative coordination role. The selected candidate must be comfortable working directly on the warehouse floor, managing materials physically, supporting system accuracy, and ensuring that goods are received, inspected, stored, picked, packed, and dispatched correctly.
q: Minimum 3 to 5 years of experience in warehouse, stores, inventory, logistics, or material coordination.
Prior experience working in a structured organization with strict SOP adherence .
Hands-on experience with ERP or computerized inventory systems .
SAP B1 experience will be an added advantage, but is not mandatory.
Practical knowledge of receiving, inspection, storage, picking, packing, dispatch, stock counting, and warehouse housekeeping.
Exposure to fasteners, fixings, industrial supplies, steel products, MEP materials, construction materials, or other complex SKU-based inventory will be preferred.
Basic QA/QC awareness related to incoming and outgoing materials.
Ability to identify materials by size, grade, finish, standard, quantity, packing, and physical condition.
Ability to use measuring tools such as measuring tape, vernier caliper, thread gauge, weighing scale, or counting scale will be preferred.
Basic working knowledge of Microsoft Excel, Word, and Outlook.
Strong attention to detail, discipline, accountability, and ability to work under pressure.
Ability to coordinate with warehouse helpers and support staff on the floor.
Qatar/GCC driving license will be an added advantage.

The ideal candidate should be a practical warehouse professional who understands that inventory accuracy begins on the warehouse floor. He should be disciplined, organized, system-oriented, quality-conscious, and capable of supporting the Inventory Controller with reliable physical stock information.
We are looking for someone who can balance hands-on material handling with ERP discipline, SOP compliance, warehouse housekeeping, and stock accuracy.
Interested candidates may apply with their updated CV.
Preference will be given to candidates currently available in Qatar with relevant warehouse, inventory, ERP, and industrial material-handling experience.
r: Maintain warehouse materials in a clean, safe, structured, and properly identified manner.
Support receiving, inspection, sorting, storing, picking, packing, issuing, returns, and dispatch activities.
Verify materials against purchase orders, delivery notes, packing lists, item descriptions, quantities, sizes, grades, finishes, and standards.
Ensure proper segregation of accepted stock, pending inspection stock, rejected materials, damaged goods, returns, and unidentified materials.
Support ERP-based inventory discipline by ensuring material movements are properly documented and reported.
Coordinate with the Inventory Controller for timely system updates, stock verification, and reconciliation.
Assist in physical stock counts, cycle counts, bin-location checks, and variance identification.
Monitor fast-moving items and support timely replenishment by reporting minimum stock and reorder-level concerns.
Ensure warehouse helpers and store staff follow approved SOPs and proper material handling practices.
Support accurate picking, packing, labelling, and dispatch to avoid wrong item, wrong quantity, or wrong material movement.
Maintain high standards of warehouse housekeeping, safety, accessibility, and stock visibility.
Report discrepancies, damaged goods, stock mismatches, wrong storage, delayed postings, or abnormal stock movement to the Inventory Controller.
